title: 12-Lead ECG
author: T. Langston, MD (Cardiology)
summary: Sinus bradycardia 50, PR 180 ms, QRS 80 ms, QT/QTc 449/410 ms, normal axis. No ST or T-wave changes. Otherwise normal ECG.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 50 bpm. PR 180 ms. QRS 80 ms. QT/QTc 449/410 ms (Bazett: RR 60/50 = 1.20 s; square root 1.095; 0.449 / 1.095 = 0.410). Normal axis.

**Interpretation**
Sinus bradycardia, rate 50. Normal PR and QRS. No ST elevation or depression. No T-wave changes. No ectopy. Otherwise normal ECG.

**Context**
Recorded at 0923 at the bedside during an episode of autonomic dysreflexia (chronic T4 spinal cord injury; BP very high, tubing kink being relieved). The slow rate fits a reflex (vagal) response to the high blood pressure. No signs of ischemia.

**Over-read**
T. Langston, MD (Cardiology), 1015. Tracing available in the chart at 0930.
impression: Sinus bradycardia, 50. Otherwise normal ECG. No ischemic changes.
